description: Nometria deployment automation hooks. Wires the scripts in this folder to the Claude Code hook lifecycle. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to the installed plugin directory.

hooks.description: Runs an AI security scan before production deploys and blocks if the score is below 70.
Triggers a resync when a git commit is made in a Nometria project.
Auto-deploys a staging preview when a PR is opened or a branch is pushed, and prints the preview URL.
After a deploy, verifies the app serves HTTP 200 and rolls back after 3 failed checks.
Resyncs the staging preview after code edits so there is always a live URL (debounced).
Lists running instances at session start and warns about idle ones to avoid surprise costs.
